description:
Retire the private git setup in the server's route tests in favour of the shared helper.

## Background

Shared test support provides a git initialisation function with a fixed author identity and no dependency on global git configuration. `crates/server/src/routes.rs` tests hand-roll `git init`; the server crate's tests enable `jit`'s `test-support` feature.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/server/src/routes.rs` tests initialise git only through the shared function.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Server unit tests initialise git through the shared helper
